question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of reused parts out of the total product mass in relation to reused content?
data_point: mass fraction of reused parts out of the total product mass
description: The mass fraction of reused parts out of the total product mass represents the proportion of the product's mass that is derived from reused sources. This metric is used to assess the circularity of a product by evaluating the extent to which it incorporates materials that have been previously used and then recycled or reused. In the context of sustainable construction, this metric can help designers and builders choose materials and products that promote a more circular economy, reducing waste and conserving resources.
